annotations.text:
Flow: Login → Connect Instagram (only when no account) → Dashboard.
Dashboard: suggestions → stat row → hit rate by label → heatmap → best reels.
Heatmap cell click opens the sheet (3a). Backfill button opens the dialog (3b).
Accept on a suggestion card creates a row on Hypotheses (5). Tagging happens on Video detail (4).

Honesty rules baked into the UI:
• every bar and cell prints hits/n
• n < 5 dims to 40%, never hidden
• 90% interval whisker on every bar
• stat row states how many combinations were screened and how many will look good by chance
• hypothesis verdicts say 'evidence, not proof'

Visuals match the installed shadcn base-mira neutral theme: Inter, 28px controls, 7px radius, #e5e5e5 borders. The only colour is one sequential blue ramp for hit rate plus green/amber/red status dots with labels.
